instruction.text: Is once being used as an adverb or a conjunction?

atoms.a: I’ve only ever had to move schools <u>once</u>.
<u>Once</u> I started at the new school, I tried to make some friends.
Things were much easier <u>once</u> I had been there a few days.

instruction.text: Is after being used as an adverb or a conjunction?

atoms.a: <u>After</u> the party was over, we all slept very deeply.
Jeff woke up at 9:30 and left shortly <u>after</u>.
Louise got to work cleaning the house <u>after</u> everyone had left.

instruction.text: Is before being used as an adverb or a conjunction?

atoms.a: Simon waited for 20 minutes <u>before</u> his friend Sandra finally arrived.
Simon had not tried this cafe <u>before</u>.
<u>Before</u> Simon ordered his sandwich, he watched a bird out the window.

instruction.text: Is since being used as an adverb or a conjunction?

atoms.a: Molly quit her job last week and Dee hasn’t seen her <u>since</u>.
<u>Since</u> she didn’t enjoy the work either, Dee decided to quit too.
Dee has been much happier <u>since</u> starting her new job.
